Chapter 7060: Another Overestimation

Chapter 7060: Another Overestimation

Another celestial immortal resembled a monstrous flame capable of ending worlds. If it appeared in Heavenrealm, it could end the current cycle.

“Heaven’s Slayer.” Others thought that although this flame didn’t seem to be as strong as Heaven’s Demise’s sealing aura, it was more dangerous.

“That’s the burner of the high heaven during the A’lai cycle?” An old immortal asked.

“That’s the one, he went missing then and everyone thought he was dead.” A golden immortal said softly.

“More infamous than Heaven’s Demise.” An immortal knew more about Slayer’s feats than Demise’s.

“Demise is older, maybe even older than Dusk.” Heaven’s Equal said softly: “Same generation as Dusk’s parents.”

“Very strong then too?” A golden immortal asked.

“He sealed the high heaven during A’lai.” Heaven’s Equal said: “It would have faced destruction much earlier and Slayer wouldn’t have had the chance to burn the high heaven.”

“What is this A’lai cycle?” Another asked.

“A’lai is what we call the final tribulation, the destruction of everything. Only a few immortals can survive. The last time this happened... virtually forgotten by now.” Heaven’s Equal explained.

“I see, so the cycles are true.” An overlord murmured.

“Yes, only a few survive. Celestial immortals and some primordial immortals. Anyone lower would have been lucky.” A golden immortal said.

Many turned toward Heaven’s Equal since he should be the most knowledgeable.

“Demise and Slayer have experienced cycles before.” Heaven’s Equal said.

“Who is the third celestial immortal?” Someone asked.

This immortal resembled a gray dragon, seemingly drinking water from the ocean. Its body resembled sludge for one second and mist for the next. However, muscles and membranes could be seen within, made from a chaotic derivation of various affinities. They seemed to be in their nascent stage, giving off a creepy and nauseating sensation.

“Dragongrasp.” Heaven’s Equal answered.

Listeners found this name unfamiliar.

“I don’t know, I only heard this title after Heaven Pit.” Heaven’s Equal said.

“Three celestial immortals. No, four.” Someone commented.

“Such an incredible fighting force during Heaven Pit.” Another said and couldn’t fathom how they lost.

“Two on the shore, two with paramita bodies.” A golden immortal said: “And then Dusk, Heavenfall with apex power, Octopus and Hidden Immortal that have let go. How was that not enough to deal with the enforcer?” A golden immortal asked.

“What birthed you?” Li Qiye only glanced at Demise and Slayer briefly before asking Dragongrasp.

“From heaven and earth.” Dragongrasp maintained his strange pose.

“From heaven and earth with the affinities as the body, seems to be the son of the high heaven, no?” One immortal whispered.

“I suppose.” A golden immortal said.

All things were born from heaven and earth. However, their body was made from some physical attributes. For example, a plant had roots while the living had flesh and blood. This entity was made from affinities such as the yin and yang, karma, and reincarnation.

“Heaven and earth can’t birth you.” Li Qiye said.

“The high heaven willed it.” Dragongrasp said.

“Another inaccurate self-assessment.” Li Qiye smiled: “In a state resembling ointment like yourself? You think too lowly of the high heaven. Although it is a bastard, its taste is beyond question.” Li Qiye said.

“Then why was I born?” Dragongrasp asked.
